title: cephaelis remyana
intro: Cephaelis remyana, commonly known as Remya or Rauwolfia of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, is a medicinal plant species belonging to the family Rubiaceae. It has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce anxiety, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The plant is known to exhibit therapeutic actions such as vasodilation, antispasmodic, and sedative effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of hypertension and stress. The bioactive constituents of Cephaelis remyana include alkaloids like remyine and remyakin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential applications.
